activity.notes: Representative beauty-business career begins with Walker's move to Denver and commercial product-selling activity in 1905 and continues through her active entrepreneurial career to her death in 1919; the start is a documented business event, not a lifespan proxy.

sources.title: Madam C. J. Walker Collection — Smithsonian Transcription Center
sources.citation_text: The Smithsonian identifies Walker as an entrepreneur (1867–1919), records her 1905 move to Denver as a sales agent and her subsequent development and expansion of her own hair-care business.

sources.title: Two American Entrepreneurs: Madam C.J. Walker and J.C. Penney — U.S. National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service records Walker arriving in Denver in 1905 and soon mixing and selling her products door to door before expanding the business.
